description: Header file defining GPU-accelerated General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) templates and functions for HIP (Heterogeneous-compute Interface for Portability) backend, including device-specific implementations and utility classes.

classes.name: AlphaBetaAdd
classes.description: Elementwise operator struct for applying alpha and beta scaling during GEMM operations.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Applies the alpha-beta scaling to the input value, specialized for float, ck::bhalf_t, and ck::half_t types.

methods.name: gemm_impl
methods.description: Template function implementing GEMM using device-specific kernels with parameters for block sizes, data types, and transposition flags.

methods.name: gemm_impl_wmma
methods.description: Template function implementing GEMM optimized with WMMA (Warp Matrix Multiply and Accumulate) for specific hardware.
